title: Jesus... I Said No To The Match. Amma Went Silent. 💔
topic: she turned down a match whose family wanted her to quit her job, and her mother hasn't spoken to her in four days

bible.text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I said no to the match. Amma hasn't spoken to me in four days. 💔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: His family wanted me to quit my job after the wedding. I still set her plate every night.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You didn't say no to her. You said no to losing yourself.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does it feel like I lost her instead?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Her silence is loud. It isn't the last word on you.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I'm not waiting for anyone's approval to hold you. Keep setting her plate.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the daughter who said no and still sets the table. 🍽️
